newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIETUMU BANK INSURES CARD HOLDERS' FOREIGN TRIPS.
newsitem.headline: RIETUMU BANK INSURES CARD HOLDERS' FOREIGN TRIPS.

text.p: Rietumu Bank, Latvia's fourth largest bank, said on Monday that it will introduce foreign travel insurance for its card holders.
The bank said in a statement that it will insure some travel risks for its Eurocard/MasterCard Gold and Silver card holders if the air fare has been paid via the card.
Rietumu said that it had issued 253 Eurocard/MasterCard cards by April, some eighty being in the Gold and Silver category.
The risks covered include flight delays for more than four hours, loss of luggage, as well as injuries.
The coverage extends to the spouses and children of card holders.
